title: Subpar blending capabilities
text: Subpar blending capabilities. Not a good blender at all. Bought it to make summer boozy slushies and they came out with gritty, chunky ice and frozen fruit pieces no matter how much I tweaked the recipe or how long I blended them for. I suppose it’s just not meant for that? Wouldn’t recommend
